success.description: Geologic map units from various data sources

parameters.map_id: integer, one or more polygon map_ids to search for
parameters.lat: A valid latitude in decimal degrees
parameters.lng: A valid longitude in decimal degrees
parameters.strat_name_id: integer, one or more valid strat_name_ids from /defs/strat_names
parameters.unit_id: integer, one or more valid unit_ids from /units

fields.name: text, the name of the entity
fields.descrip: text, description of entity in plain text
fields.macro_units: array of integers, the unit_ids of Macrostrat units matched to the polygon or unit_link
fields.strat_names: array of integer, strat_name_ids matched to the polygon or unit_link
fields.t_int_id: integer, the ID of the chronostratigraphic interval containing the top boundary of the unit
fields.t_int_age: float, the top age of the chronostratigraphic interval containing the top boundary of the unit
fields.t_int_name: text, the name of the chronostratigraphic interval containing the top boundary of the unit
fields.b_int_id: integer, the ID of the chronostratigraphic interval containing the bottom boundary of the unit
fields.b_int_age: float, the bottom age of the chronostratigraphic interval containing the bottom boundary of the unit
fields.b_int_name: text, the name of the chronostratigraphic interval containing the bottom boundary of the unit
fields.color: text, recommended coloring for units based on dominant lithology
fields.scale: text, the Burwell scale the source belongs to
